title: Pixzy menu Universal
features:
🚀 Pixzy menu Universal | Keyless, Clean & Fully Loaded

A powerful, smooth, and completely keyless universal script designed to enhance your gameplay across Roblox titles. Built for high performance, stability, and ease of use without annoying ad-links or keys.

✨ Features

Visuals & ESP

Player ESP: Highlights players through walls with configurable options.

Tracers & Nametags: Displays clear lines, player display names, health bars, and exact distance.

Box & Chams: Customizable 2D bounding boxes and character mesh highlighting.

Combat & Targeting

Aimbot & Silent Aim: Precision target locking targeting head or torso.

Target Strafe & Auto-Rotate: Automatically tracks and circles around locked opponents in combat.

Kill Aura: Automatically strikes nearby targets within your designated hit range.

Movement & Physics

Fly & Noclip: Seamless flight controls with zero clip collision through walls.

Infinite Jump: Continuous air jumping by overriding jump velocity.

Speed & Jump Modifiers: On-the-fly sliders to adjust WalkSpeed and JumpPower.

Teleportation: Quick-teleport to selected players or set map locations.

Quality of Life & Settings

100% Keyless: Direct execution with zero link hubs, captchas, or daily keys.

Config Manager: Automatically saves and loads your custom toggles and color schemes.

FPS Booster: Anti-lag toggles to clear map textures/decals for smooth execution on lower-end and mobile devices.

📌 Execution Info

Game Support: Universal (Works across most Roblox games)

Mobile Compatible: Fully tested on Delta, Fluxus, and Hydrogen.
